title: Add chat message rate-limiting to prevent personality-driven timer timeouts
description:
In game_20260302_005956_g4, Grok4F Valley (grok-4-fast with valley-girl personality) sent 71 chat messages — narrating nearly every priority pass with multi-sentence valley-girl monologues. This caused:

1. Enormous token waste: ~2000-3000 output tokens on pure personality fluff
2. Context window exhaustion → context trim → 11-minute empty-response/timeout cascade
3. Timer timeout loss despite winning 27 life to 3

The root cause is architectural: `send_chat_message` is classified as INFO_ONLY_TOOLS in pilot.py (line 491) with no rate-limiting. The model can call it unlimited times without triggering stall detection.

Additionally, the chat nudge system (pilot.py lines 1003-1009) actively reminds models to chat every 2 turns, exacerbating expressive personalities.

Suggested fix: Add a per-turn chat message budget (e.g., max 2 per turn cycle). After the budget is exhausted, silently drop or return a brief 'chat limit reached' message instead of sending. This preserves personality flavor without burning context.

Evidence:
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260302_005956_g4/Grok4F Valley_pilot.log: 71 send_chat_message calls
- ~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260302_005956_g4/Grok4F Valley_pilot.log lines 623-666: 11-minute timeout/empty-response cascade
- puppeteer/src/puppeteer/pilot.py line 491: INFO_ONLY_TOOLS has no rate limit
- puppeteer/src/puppeteer/pilot.py lines 1003-1009: chat nudge system
